notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
- Fixed the problem that the judgment remains when switching between AutoShoot and AutoAbsorb and the problem that a certain ability is activated.
- Fixed the bullet cancellation function of a certain ability slightly upward.

notes.title: Corrections and announcements
notes.content:
- Fixed so that the collision detection is not interrupted when rolling is continuous.

Sorry for the overlapping updates.
We are paying close attention to eliminating problems and improving the game, so we apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

If you have any problems, we would appreciate it if you could tell us the operating environment and situation in detail. I cannot guarantee that I will be able to handle it, but I will confirm it. The more details you have, the more likely you are to improve.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
The following issues have been updated.

- Fixed an issue where the increase / decrease of enemies was not applied depending on the difficulty level.
- Fixed a minor bug related to Enemy "Blocken"
